name: christianpure-saints
title: Saints with feast days in the Western and Orthodox calendars
description: 378 saints with their feast days in the Western and Orthodox calendars, patronages, a line on what each is known for, and the sources for each. The data behind the Christian Pure saint finder at https://christianpure.com/saint-finder/.

sources.title: Vatican News, Saint of the day
Orthodox Church in America, Lives of the Saints
Martyrologium Romanum (2004) and the Roman Martyrology (1916), via the Internet Archive

fields.name: saint_id
fields.description: Id of the saint, as in the finder’s addresses (?saint=<id>).

fields.name: western_feast
fields.description: Feast day in the Western (Roman Catholic) calendar, as MM-DD. Empty where the West keeps no feast.

fields.name: western_feast_note
fields.description: Note on the Western date, such as the calendar that keeps it.

fields.name: orthodox_feast
fields.description: Feast day in the Orthodox calendar, as MM-DD on the civil (Gregorian) calendar, as new-calendar churches keep it. Empty where no Orthodox feast was found.

fields.name: orthodox_feast_note
fields.description: Note on the Orthodox date, or why there is none.

fields.name: orthodox_old_calendar_also
fields.description: true where the old-calendar churches (Russian, Serbian, Jerusalem, Mount Athos) also keep the feast, 13 days later on the civil calendar. false where only new-calendar churches keep it, or it could not be told.

fields.name: orthodox_old_calendar_date
fields.description: The civil date (MM-DD) on which old-calendar churches keep the feast: orthodox_feast plus 13 days, counted in a common year.

fields.name: patron_of
fields.description: Patronages, separated by "; ". Empty where none was sourced.

fields.name: titles
fields.description: Titles and traditional descriptions, separated by "; ".

fields.name: name_forms
fields.description: First names the finder matches to this saint, lower case, separated by "; ".

fields.name: known_for
fields.description: One line on what the saint is known for. Our words.

fields.name: finder_url
fields.description: The saint’s page in the Christian Pure saint finder.

resources.name: saint-sources
resources.title: Sources
resources.description: One row per source of each saint.

fields.name: source_order
fields.description: Order of the source for the saint, from 1.

resources.name: saints-json
resources.title: Saints as JSON
resources.description: The same saints, one object each, with their sources inside.
